items.title: Joseph 'One Eyed Babe' Phillips Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: No, I know love when I come in the city by playing dance with him.

ctx.x: What, everybody jammed up against the door and they couldn't get out? Yeah, they just jammed up trying to get out. Charlie Locke told me the only one that got out was the bass player and he walked out carrying his bass with it. Walked out and just kept his head and pushed his way with it. Push his way with it. Hey, Phillip. It's March 25, 1957, reel 2. Play those red hook numbers. Mm-mm.
Yeah, play many dance with love. No. And I played a long time at the night club across the river. That's fake. Oh, yeah. With Thomas. Did you know love in the country? No.
I know Love when I come in the city by playing dance with him.
